title: handle_state_change: Message/changes + Message/get are sequential; Chat reload is another serial JMAP call
description: On a Message state change, handle_state_change makes two sequential JMAP calls (Message/changes then Message/get). If both Chat and Message state changes arrive in the SSE buffer at nearly the same time (common at startup), they are processed one at a time: the select! picks one, handle_state_change makes 2-3 serial HTTP calls, then loops back to pick the next. This is inherent to the sequential event loop design and not a hot-path issue for a chat app with low message volume. Noted for completeness; not worth fixing at current scale.
